title: Re-generate Summary Delete button implementation and produce a fresh deployable draft

requirements.text: Implement (or re-implement) the dedicated Summary Delete control as a trash icon button in the top-right corner of the Summary card. When clicked, it must clear ONLY the Summary text (set summary state to an empty string) and must not modify the Quiz section/state in any way.

quotes: re‑generate the code for the Summary Delete button step before deploying again?

acceptanceCriteria: When a summary is displayed, the Summary card shows a trash icon button positioned in the card’s top-right corner (inside the card header area).

Clicking the trash icon clears the summary content by setting the Summary state to an empty string, and the Summary section no longer renders (since the dashboard currently only renders the Summary section when `summary` is truthy).
Clicking the Summary delete control does not change `quizArray` state; any rendered Quiz section remains visible and unchanged.
The existing Quiz delete button continues to delete only the quiz content and does not affect the Summary state.
All user-facing text remains in English.

requirements.text: Wire the Summary Delete button into Dashboard state management by adding a Summary delete handler in the Dashboard page and passing it into the SummaryCard component via props, without changing the existing Quiz delete handler or QuizSection behavior.

quotes: re‑generate the code for the Summary Delete button step before deploying again?

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx` includes a dedicated handler that clears only the summary state (e.g., `setSummary('')`).
`frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx` accepts an `onDelete` (or equivalent) callback prop and calls it when the trash icon button is clicked.
No changes are made that couple Summary deletion to Quiz deletion (e.g., Summary deletion must not call `setQuizArray([])`).

requirements.text: Create a new build draft from the updated repository state and run the standard build + deployment pipeline to produce a fresh deployment.

quotes: re‑generate the code for the Summary Delete button step before deploying again?

acceptanceCriteria: A new build draft is created successfully (no “You don’t have a draft yet” deployment error).
The build passes TypeScript compilation and the frontend build step.
A fresh deployment is produced and is accessible at the generated deployment URL(s).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose only).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo). Do not introduce additional backend services.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not re-enable or re-add the Ask AI UI (it must remain hidden/disabled).
Do not change webhook configuration behavior beyond what is required for the Summary delete button work.
Do not add database/persistent storage for Summary or Quiz content (local in-memory state only).
